ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated at the distal tips and the central basal region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white zones are mapped to the extreme left and right distal tips. A cluster of high-intensity pixels is located at the lower central insertion point. Sparse, localized white mottling is distributed across the primary low-intensity black lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 75-degree angle at the center-point convergence of the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels, most prominent on the outer thirds of both trailing edges; the inner thirds toward the notch exhibit lower frequency variation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curvature transitioning from the distal tips toward the median notch, with convex rounding at the outer lateral corners.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicating barnacle colonization/scarring. Isolated white circular spots are scattered across the dark regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the dark pigmentation of both lobes, with a prominent set of parallel diagonal lines on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the ventral surface and dense white scarring/barnacle attachment at both lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, high-contrast white pigmentation patch shaped roughly like a 'Y' or 'T' located at the central base of the fluke where it meets the peduncle.
